4494: Satsuki is the main character of the show.
4495: Momoko is a 6th grader and Satsuki's best friend. She seems to fear nothing, even in very dangerous situations, and is very brave when it comes to helping Satsuki and the gang confront the ghosts. She also seems to have a psychic connection with Satsuki's mother.
4497: Hajime is Satsuki's neighbor. He is always strong and courageous to help defeat the ghosts, but though he says that this is very brave, he is actually a coward. Despite this, he is one of the most reliable of Satsuki's friends and has saved her on more than one occasion.
4498: Reo is Hajime's friend and has a big obsession with paranormal themes, and proclaims himself as a respected paranormal researcher. However, whenever Reo finds a clue pertaining to the existence of supernatural entities, it seems that the clue turns against him.
4500: Keiichirou is Satsuki's young brother. He is easily frightened by many things and is seen crying sometimes, but he shows courage where it counts to help in defeating the ghosts. He creates a special friendship with the ghost Amanojaku.
12738: A doll that the kids find on a trash can. They leave the doll there and go home. Later Satsuki finds the doll in her and her brother's house.
12786: Amanojaku is a powerful entity that, long ago, was sealed by Satsuki's mother in a tree in the mountains, but was finally released from his magic prison due to urbanization.
30220: Sakata is the teacher of the class where Satsuki, Hajime and Reo attend. Despite he doesn't believe in ghosts, he suffered many supernatural issues, as he was possessed, cursed and kidnapped by ghosts a couple of times.
30221: Reiichirou is Satsuki's father. He has no clue about his daughter's supernatural duties and also doesn't believe in ghosts.
30222: Kayako is Satsuki's and Keiichirou's deceased mother. Through her diary it is revealed that she was an avid exorcist during her childhood.
32553: Datto is a ghost who was killed in a car accident and helped Keiichirou in training for race. Since he died by being hit by a car while he was training to win the race game of the sports festival, he slashes off and gathers legs of sprint runners.
46717: Hanako is the ghost of a little girl that haunts the ladies' restroom of the old school building. She appears to be harmless and has no intention to scare people, for she only wants to play and make friends.
47037: Akane is a girl who died of a sudden heart attack during a radio show in the old school. Since then, her ghost curses all those who hear her voice and they will die at the sunset of the same day. She was sealed in the microphone by Satsuki's mother, Kayako.
47039: The ghost of the German composer Ludwig van Beethoven.
47041: A demon hag (more like an Onibaba) who appears in the 8th episode. According to Satsuki's mom's diary he used to take lost people to the boats of the Sanzu River and then forced them to enter in a boat to cross the river, in other words to the underworld.
47043: Translated as "Red Paper Blue Paper", Akagami-Aogami haunts the restrooms asking to his victims if they want red paper or blue paper.
47045: The ghost of a taxi driver who died in a car accident inside of the damned tunnel Ananmaneki when he tried to arrive at home for his daughter's birthday.
53687: The last and most muscular ghost to be presented, Lord Ohma is a very powerful evil deity capable of controlling other ghosts even if they are sealed away. He holds a hateful grudge against Kayako Miyanoshita.
53689: Shinobu is, in the beginning, featured as one of Satsuki's classmates. She seems to know black magic, as she teaches it to the other girls of the class so they can grant their wishes.
246675: Mio Imai is Satsuki's friend and classmate that appeared in The Corpse that Roams in the Night – Shirotabi. She is a shy girl that was friend of her bunny, Shirotabi. Shirotabi died, and Mio became really sad.
